association: Two G alleles are associated with lighter/blue eyes in studied European cohorts
limitation: Other pigmentation genes and population background substantially affect eye color; this is not a complete phenotype predictor

association: The A allele is associated with lactase persistence in several European-derived populations
limitation: Other persistence alleles exist; this marker does not diagnose lactose intolerance or symptoms

association: Two T alleles are associated with dry earwax
limitation: This is one trait association, not a health assessment; genomic alleles are forward-strand GRCh38
